get.summary: The server's version and its link to the engine host.
Recently opened projects, most recent first.

post.summary: Creates a project folder and opens it, closing the open one (unsaved edits are kept in its backup).
Opens a project folder, closing the open one.

get.summary: The open project, with its revision as the ETag; 404 when none is open.

post.summary: Applies a batch of edits atomically as one undo step. With If-Match, a stale revision answers 409; an edit that does not apply (an unknown id, a split outside the region) answers 422 and changes nothing.
Undoes the last edit; 422 when there is nothing to undo.
Copies an uploaded WAV into the project's Audio Files folder (a browser on the network).
Copies a WAV from the server's disk into the project's Audio Files folder (the desktop app).

get.summary: Waveform peaks of a file in the binary format of PeakFormat (Anode.Contracts), at the nearest kept resolution to framesPerPeak, optionally only peaks start … start + count.

post.summary: Play, stop, record or locate. Recording needs an open project and a record-armed track.

AudioFile.description: An audio file of the project; `path` is relative to the project folder.

AudioRegion.description:
A region of an audio file on a track: it starts at `startTick` and plays `length` frames of the file
from `fileOffset`, at `gainDb`, with linear fades of `fadeIn` and `fadeOut` frames.

ChannelStrip.description: Volume in dB (−∞ as −144), pan −1 (left) … 1 (right), mute and solo.

CommandBatch.description: Edits applied as one undo step; `label` names it in the undo history ("Move Region").

CommandResult.description: What an edit, undo or redo did: the new revision and the delta every client receives too.

DeltaOpTrackUpserted.description: A track was added or changed; `index` is its position in the track list.

EditCommand.description:
An edit of the open project (docs/adr/0004-state-ownership.md). A batch of them is applied atomically as one
undo step. Optional properties left out are left unchanged.

EditCommandAddRegionCommand.description: Places a file on a track; the whole file unless `fileOffset` and `length` say otherwise.

EditCommandAddTrackCommand.description: Adds an audio track at `index` (the end when left out).

EditCommandMoveRegionCommand.description: Moves a region in time, and to another track when `trackId` is given.

EditCommandResizeRegionCommand.description: Trims a region: its new start, and the part of the file it plays.

EditCommandSetStripCommand.description: Changes a track's channel strip, or the master's when `trackId` is left out.

EditCommandSplitRegionCommand.description: Splits a region in two at `atTick`, which must fall inside it.

EngineStatus.description:
The server's link to the engine host: whether it is reachable (`state`), the host's version and audio
backend (`coreaudio`, `wasapi`, `alsa`, `null`) from its hello while connected, and why the
link is down when it is (`message`).

ImportFileRequest.description: Import an audio file the server can read from its own disk (the desktop app, a headless box's library).

MetronomeSettings.description: The click: on or off, a one-bar count-in before recording, and its level in dB.

Project.description:
The open project (docs/01-implementation-plan.md §5). Musical positions are ticks at 960 PPQ; audio offsets,
lengths and fades are frames at the project's `sampleRate`. `revision` grows with every edit and is
the ETag; `dirty` says whether it has unsaved edits.

ProjectDelta.description:
What changed between two revisions of the open project (docs/adr/0004-state-ownership.md). Clients apply the
operations in order; a client that misses a revision refetches the project.

ProjectSettings.description: Global settings. `endTick` is the project end marker.

ProjectSummary.description: A project in the recent list.

SystemInfo.description: What `GET /api/v1/system` answers: the server's version and its link to the engine host.

Track.description:
A track and its channel strip. `color` is a CSS colour; `input` is where recording takes its audio
from.

TrackInput.description: The device input: 1-based first channel (0: none); a stereo input takes that channel and the next.

TransportRequest.description: Play, stop or record (from `tick` when given), or locate the playhead to `tick`.

TransportStatus.description: The playhead: state and position, in samples and ticks.

UndoHistory.description: The undo stack (most recent first) and the redo stack (next first).
